title: BC Transit — identity evidence timeline
scope: Corporate logo families, observed variants, organizational context and livery changes; not every local transit-system or service brand.
datePolicy: Unknown adoption and retirement dates are null. A dated publication is evidence of use, not a launch date. Unknown-date assets are not forced onto an exact year.

events.title: Urban Transit Authority formed
events.note: The provincial government establishes the UTA. This is predecessor history, not a BC Transit logo-adoption date.

events.title: Victoria and Vancouver operations transfer
events.note: Operations transfer from BC Hydro. Do not attach a new logo to this administrative event without artwork evidence.

events.title: UTA becomes BC Transit
events.note: BC Transit’s own history gives 1982. The introduction date of the horizontal flag lockup remains unknown.

events.title: Metro Vancouver passes to TransLink
events.note: Record a jurisdictional handover, not the disappearance of BC Transit or a logo redesign.

events.title: Earlier exterior-design milestone
events.note: The 2024 explanation dates the previous notable exterior bus-design change to 2007. This alone does not date adoption of the loop logo.

events.title: Flag lockup in the 2008 service plan
events.note: The cover has an angled provincial flag above the name. This dates a publication using it, not the start or end of the identity.

events.title: Loop and tagline documented by 2009
events.note: The service plan shows the blue-and-green loop, italic wordmark and “Linking Communities, Businesses & Lifestyles”. Its exact launch remains unresolved.

events.title: Green bus livery; logo unchanged
events.note: The new exterior design is announced in September; rollout begins that fall on new buses. BC Transit explicitly says there is no logo change.

families.label: Flag-based identity
families.note: The supplied horizontal flag image and the stacked report lockup differ. They are not assigned consecutive eras without transition evidence.

families.label: Loop and italic wordmark
families.note: The supplied navy and full-colour/tagline files are variants of this family, not proven successive redesigns. Their exact publication dates are unknown.
